subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks a CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` expose to callers?
rationale: The source-level mismatch is clear, but changing blocked-hook output affects a public machine-readable result surface and a plugin-enforced safety boundary.

options.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
options.body: Use the post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured suppressed/blocked result without raw text when the hook blocks persistence.

options.title: Thread hook output only for rewrites
options.body: Fix rewritten-message mismatches first while requiring a separate maintainer decision for blocked-message JSON shape.

options.title: Document persistence-only semantics
options.body: Leave `before_message_write` as transcript-only and explicitly document that `agent --json` may expose raw CLI output, accepting the security tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
recommendation.body: Use the post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured suppressed/blocked result without raw text when the hook blocks persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook PR and explicitly kept this issue open when closing the stale candidate implementation.
